dataset_metadata.disclaimer: New AI-generated English drafts of the recorded Classical Chinese; not scholarly reviewed. Original source interpretations are not verified geometry or modern etymology.

shuowen:9501.text: Where the spokes gather. Formed from 車, with 𣪊 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9502.text: The appearance of hubs being level and equal. Formed from 車, with 昆 indicating the sound. The Rites of Zhou says: 'Looking at the hubs, one wants them even.'

shuowen:9503.text: The end or covering of a long hub, bound in red. Formed from 車, with 氏 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'Bound hubs and decorated crossbars.'

shuowen:9504.text: A small opening in a wheel. Formed from 車, with 只 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9505.text: The end of a carriage axle. Formed from 車; a pictograph. Du Lin's explanation.

shuowen:9506.text: A wheel's spokes. Formed from 車, with 畐 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9507.text: The ribs of a canopy. Alternatively, wheel spokes. Formed from 車, with 𤋯 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9508.text: An axle-end sleeve. Formed from 車, with 大 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9509.text: A sleeve fitted over the end of a hub. Formed from 車, with 官 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9510.text: A carriage shaft. Formed from 車, with 袁 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9511.text: A carriage shaft. Formed from 車, with 舟 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9512.text: The 纩 fitting of a straight-shafted carriage; the technical term is unclear. Formed from 車, with 具 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9513.text: What holds the crossbar at the end of a carriage shaft. Formed from 車, with 元 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9514.text: The front of a carriage shaft. Formed from 車, with 戹 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9515.text: The curved fitting of a yoke. Formed from 車, with 軍 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9516.text: The curved part beneath a yoke. Formed from 車, with 句 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9517.text: What carries the reins on a carriage crossbar. Formed from 車, with 義 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9518.text: The inner reins of the outside horses, fastened before the carriage crossbar. Formed from 車, with 内 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'Moisten it to 𧥎 the inner reins,' as the obscure source quotation records.

shuowen:9519.text: A carriage shaking. Formed from 車 and 行. Alternatively, abbreviated 衍 indicates the sound.

shuowen:9520.text: The rear step of a light carriage. Formed from 車, with 丞 indicating the sound. Read like 抍 in the Changes' 抍馬.

shuowen:9521.text: To ride or carry. Formed from 車, with 𢦔 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9522.text: To encircle. Four thousand men make a 軍. Formed from 車 and abbreviated 包. 軍 means war carriages.

shuowen:9523.text: Before setting out on a journey, one must first announce it to the road deity, making an altar open in four directions and planting thatch for the deity to rest upon: this is 軷. After sacrificing, one drives over the victim and departs: this is 範軷. The Odes says: 'Take a ram for the road sacrifice.' Formed from 車, with 犮 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9524.text: The driving-over expressed by 範軷. Formed from 車, with abbreviated 笵 indicating the sound. Pronounced the same as 犯.

shuowen:9525.text: The appearance of a high load. Formed from 車, with abbreviated 𣡌 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9526.text: The sound of a carriage. Formed from 車, with 害 indicating the sound. Alternatively, 轄 means a fastening pin.

shuowen:9527.text: To turn or convey. Formed from 車, with 專 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9528.text: To convey and deliver. Formed from 車, with 俞 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9529.text: Heavy. Formed from 車, with 周 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9530.text: When an army dispatches carriages, one hundred vehicles form one 輩. Formed from 車, with 非 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9531.text: To crush by rolling over. Formed from 車, with 乙 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9532.text: To run over. Formed from 車, with 㞋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9533.text: What a carriage treads upon. Formed from 車, with 樂 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9534.text: A carriage's tracks. Formed from 車, with 九 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9535.text: A carriage's tracks. Formed from 車, with abbreviated 從 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9536.text: Carriages passing one another. Formed from 車, with 失 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9537.text: The carriage fitting or sound called 䡩𨥺; the technical sense is unclear. Formed from 車, with 眞 indicating the sound. Read like 鏗 in the Analects' 'With a clang he set aside his zither and rose'; also read like 掔.

shuowen:9538.text: To press against. Formed from 車, with 埶 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9539.text: A carriage being twisted or awry. Formed from 車, with 匡 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9540.text: A carriage with a small break that is joined again. Formed from 車, with 叕 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9541.text: To obstruct. Formed from 車, with 多 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9542.text: Carriage axle-pins striking each other. Formed from 車 and 毄; 毄 also indicates the sound. The Rites of Zhou says: 'Boats and carriages striking one another.'

shuowen:9543.text: To work on a carriage axle. Formed from 車, with 算 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9544.text: A carriage with a joined axle. Formed from 車, with 可 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9545.text: A carriage being sturdy. Formed from 車, with 殸 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9546.text: To push a carriage backward so that it reaches a place of delivery. Formed from 車 and 付. Read like 胥.

shuowen:9547.text: With spokes it is called 輪; without spokes, 輇. Formed from 車, with 侖 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9548.text: The low wheel beneath a screened carriage. Alternatively, a wheel without spokes. Formed from 車, with 全 indicating the sound. Read like 饌.

shuowen:9549.text: What holds the crossbar at the shaft-end of a large carriage. Formed from 車, with 兒 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9550.text: The rear of a large carriage. Formed from 車, with 氐 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9551.text: The matting of a large carriage. Formed from 車, with 秦 indicating the sound. Read like 臻.

shuowen:9552.text: In 淮陽, a carriage's arched top is called 轒. Formed from 車, with 賁 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9553.text: A weight at the rear of a large carriage. Formed from 車, with 宛 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9554.text: A large horse-drawn carriage. Formed from 車, with 共 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9555.text: Linked carriages. Alternatively, backing a carriage against the hall is called 𨌅. Formed from 車, with abbreviated 差 indicating the sound. Read like 遟.

shuowen:9556.text: A hand-drawn carriage. Formed from 車 and 㚘 pulling it from the front.

shuowen:9557.text: To pull it. Formed from 車, with 免 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9558.text: A spinning wheel. Alternatively, a one-wheeled carriage. Formed from 車, with 㞷 indicating the sound. Read like 狂.

shuowen:9559.text: To tear a person apart with carriages. Formed from 車, with 瞏 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'Tear them apart with carriages at the Li gate.'

shuowen:9560.text: To sever. Formed from 車 and 斤. The punishment of 斬 is tearing apart by carriages.

shuowen:9561.text: A funeral carriage. Formed from 車, with 而 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9562.text: A person's jawbones. Formed from 車, with 甫 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9563.text: The sound of many carriages. Formed from three 車.

shuowen:9564.text: A carriage's name. Formed from 車, with 孱 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9565.text: The sound of carriages. Formed from 車, with 粦 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9566.text: A carriage's tracks. Formed from 車, with abbreviated 徹 indicating the sound. Originally 徹 was used interchangeably; later people added this character.

shuowen:9567.text: A small hill. A pictograph. All characters in this group are formed from 𠂤.

shuowen:9568.text: Precariously high. Formed from 𠂤, with 屮 indicating the sound. Read like 臬.

shuowen:9569.text: An official who serves the ruler. Formed from 宀 and 𠂤. 𠂤 signifies a multitude; the same conception as 師.

shuowen:9570.text: A large tract of raised land; a mountain without rocks. A pictograph. All characters in this group are formed from 𨸏.

shuowen:9571.text: A great hill. Formed from 𨸏, with 夌 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9572.text: A great hill. Formed from 𨸏, with 鯀 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9573.text: The veins or structure of the earth. Formed from 𨸏, with 力 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9574.text: Dark: the south side of water and north side of a mountain. Formed from 𨸏, with 侌 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9575.text: High and bright. Formed from 𨸏, with 昜 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9576.text: High, level ground. Formed from 𨸏 and 坴; 坴 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:9577.text: A great hill. Alternatively, a curved hill. Formed from 𨸏, with 可 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9578.text: A slope. Alternatively, a spreading branch of water. Formed from 𨸏, with 皮 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9579.text: Sloping ground is called 阪. Alternatively, a barrier in a marsh; alternatively, a mountainside. Formed from 𨸏, with 反 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9580.text: A corner of a slope. Formed from 𨸏, with 取 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9581.text: A corner. Formed from 𨸏, with 禺 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9582.text: Obstructed and difficult. Formed from 𨸏, with 僉 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9583.text: To obstruct. Alternatively, a threshold. Formed from 𨸏, with 艮 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9584.text: Difficult or dangerous. Formed from 𨸏, with 且 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9585.text: 陮隗 means high. Formed from 𨸏, with 隹 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9586.text: The height expressed by 陮隗. Formed from 𨸏, with 鬼 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9587.text: High. Alternatively, stone. Formed from 𨸏, with 允 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9588.text: Stones piled up. Formed from 𨸏, with 𠂹 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9589.text: Steep. Formed from 𨸏, with 肖 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9590.text: Steep and high. Formed from 𨸏, with 夋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9591.text: To look or rise upward. Formed from 𨸏, with 登 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9592.text: Cramped and narrow. Formed from 𨸏, with 㔷 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9593.text: Narrow. Formed from 𨸏, with 夾 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9594.text: To ascend. Formed from 𨸏 and 步.

shuowen:9595.text: To descend from high to low. Alternatively, to fall. Formed from 𨸏 and 臽; 臽 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:9596.text: Wet ground below a slope. Formed from 𨸏, with 㬎 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9597.text: The condition expressed by 𢼮; its sense is unclear. Formed from 𨸏, with 區 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9598.text: To fall downward. Formed from 𨸏, with 貴 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9599.text: To fall from a height. Formed from 𨸏, with 㒸 indicating the sound.

shuowen:9600.text: To descend. Formed from 𨸏, with 夅 indicating the sound.
